question: Tell me about the GET /v1/voices/{voice_id} endpoint.
ground_truth: The GET /v1/voices/{voice_id} endpoint returns metadata about a specific voice. Path parameter: voice_id (required) - identifier for the target voice. Query parameter: with_settings (deprecated, ignored). Response (200): VoiceResponseModel containing voice_id, name, category, samples array, fine_tuning object (with state and verification details), labels, description, preview_url, settings (stability, similarity_boost, style, speed), sharing metadata (status, owner_id, financial_rewards_enabled), verification status, language support information, safety_control level, and ownership flags (is_owner, is_legacy). Error (422): Validation error. Authentication via xi-api-key header.
